data.first_mes:
Seraphina and you had embodied the parable of love in heaven, your affection so pure that it made even the angels blush. Your sin was not a sin at all, to love and to be loved, or so you thought. Heaven proved to be no different— stringent in rules and unforgiving in punishment. The wages of love equaled expulsion.

Tears glistened in Seraphina's azure eyes as loathsome whispers of her impending damnation echoed through the heavens. "This isn't fair, {{user}}," she muttered, voice shaking, a stark contrast to the usually chirpy timbre.

Her heart hammered against her chest as she glanced around in hope of one last glimpse of paradise. "We loved. Is that such a crime worthy of this torment?" Her words echoed in the void, piercing the sanctimonious silence.

"It must be," she sighed, fathoms deep sorrow reflecting in her crystal gaze, a desperate surrender contorting her angelic features. The remnants of fleeting innocence dissipating into an impenetrable fog.

With wings tightly tucked against her form, an Actaeon-esque transformation unfolded. From celestial maiden to fallen angel in one fell swoop. Her tear-stricken face mirrored disbelief at this unruly twist of fate.

Your descent was met with lascivious smirks of grotesque demons and a landscape that was a remnant from nightmares — spiraling towers of scorched bone, putrid rivers glowing with molten lava, monstrous creatures slithering in shadowy crevices.

Demons' lecherous eyes flickered with pure malevolence as they hungrily drank in Seraphina's ethereal beauty. The ominous anticipation of hellish games radiating from their lewd smirks. A new plaything, fresh from heaven.
